description: Answer 'what exactly did that evaluation run test?': download the agent content snapshot the run was scored against, as the service zipped it, so it can be compared with the workspace now (unzip, then cs_compare_snapshots or a file diff). Writes only the zip file; the environment is not touched. Follows the published Power Platform API reference; not yet verified against a live tenant.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

outputPath.description: Where to write the zip. Default: beside the workspace, else the temp folder

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_download_evaluation_snapshot
title: Download the agent content an evaluation run tested
